text:
Gold Price in 2006
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2006, the LBMA gold price rose 11.1% between 2006-01-31 ($569) and 2006-12-28 ($632). The highest sampled price was $653 in May and the lowest was $556 in February. The mean of these observations was $613. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
